# Paw Proxy (paw-proxy)

> Zero-config HTTPS for local macOS development: every dev server gets a trusted https://<name>.test address. A local CA, .test DNS and a reverse proxy, the `up` command, and a menu bar app (Paw Proxy.app) that shows your routes. macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon.

The `paw-proxy` daemon resolves `*.test` to `127.0.0.1`, issues trusted TLS certificates on demand, and reverse-proxies HTTPS traffic to your dev server's local port. `up` wraps your dev command: it picks a free port, sets `PORT`, registers the name and keeps it alive with heartbeats. Run `up bun dev` and your app is at `https://myapp.test`. Both commands ship inside Paw Proxy.app, which runs the daemon as its background item.

## Installation

- [Homebrew install and setup](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy#installation): `brew install --cask alexcatdad/tap/paw-proxy`, then `sudo paw-proxy setup` once
- Upgrade: `brew upgrade --cask paw-proxy`; uninstall: `sudo paw-proxy uninstall`, then `brew uninstall --cask paw-proxy`

## Usage

- [Quick start and examples](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy#usage): `up bun dev`, `up -n myapp npm start`
- [Docker Compose](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy#docker-compose): `up docker compose up` gives each service with a published port `https://<service>.<project>.test`
- [Git worktrees](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy#git-worktrees): a name already in use falls back to the directory name
- [Environment variables](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy#up): PORT, APP_DOMAIN, APP_URL, HTTPS, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
- [Command reference](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy#commands): setup, uninstall, status, restart, logs, doctor, run, version
- Menu bar app: status, routes (click to open), a badge when something needs attention, and opt-in "project is live" notifications (Settings › Notify me when projects go live; silent unless Play a sound is on)

### CLI Quick Reference

`paw-proxy` commands:
- `sudo paw-proxy setup` — Generate and trust the CA, configure the .test resolver, register the daemon through Paw Proxy.app
- `paw-proxy status` — Show daemon status and registered routes
- `paw-proxy restart` — Restart the daemon (e.g. after an upgrade)
- `paw-proxy logs [-f]` — Show or follow daemon logs
- `paw-proxy doctor` — Check socket, daemon, DNS answers, system resolution and HTTPS TLS
- `sudo paw-proxy uninstall` — Remove all components

`up` usage:
- `up <command>` — Find free port, register route, set PORT env var, run command
- `up -n name <command>` — Use custom domain name
- `up --restart <command>` — Auto-restart on crash

## Troubleshooting

- [Common issues](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy#troubleshooting): Firefox certificate trust, daemon not running, port conflicts
- Run `paw-proxy doctor` for automated diagnostics
- Logs at `~/Library/Logs/paw-proxy.log` or via `paw-proxy logs -f`

## Architecture

- [README](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/README.md): Overview and how-it-works diagram
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Invariants, layout, build and verify
- [Full LLM reference](https://alexcatdad.github.io/paw-proxy/llms-full.txt): Self-contained complete reference with API docs and troubleshooting

### Key Source Files

- [daemon.go](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/internal/daemon/daemon.go): Main daemon lifecycle (DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, cleanup goroutines)
- [routes.go](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/internal/api/routes.go): Route registry with RWMutex, heartbeat timeout
- [server.go](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/internal/api/server.go): Unix socket API, input validation (SSRF prevention)
- [proxy.go](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/internal/proxy/proxy.go): HTTP forwarding and WebSocket proxy
- [cert.go](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/internal/ssl/cert.go): Certificate generation and LRU cache
- [setup_darwin.go](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/blob/main/internal/setup/setup_darwin.go): macOS setup (CA, keychain, resolver, daemon hand-off to the app)
- [macos/](https://github.com/alexcatdad/paw-proxy/tree/main/macos): Paw Proxy.app, the menu bar app (Swift, MenubarKit)
